KGMU Entrance Examination 2022 is an opportunity offered by King George's Medical University (KGMU), Lucknow
for master's degree holders. The selected candidates will receive variable awards.
To be eligible, an applicant must -

Hold a Master's degree in Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Biochemistry or equivalent with a valid National level fellowship (JRF/SRF of various funding agencies e.g. CSIR, UGC, DST, DBT, etc.) INSPIRE or other equivalent fellowship
Have high motivation to pursue biomedical research for two PhD positions
Have experience in Stem Cell/Cell Culture, Molecular Biology (NGS, Microarray, RT-PCR etc.), Virology etc.
The selected candidates will receive variable awards.
